title: (Pwn2Own) Oracle Autonomous AI Database APEX Integrity Check Interpretation Conflict Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass form integrity controls on affected installations of Oracle Autonomous AI Database. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the APEX form integrity verification framework. The issue results from an inconsistency in how data is normalized between verification and use. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to bypass authentication on the system.
addtionnal_details:
Oracle has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://www.oracle.com/security-alerts/cspunov2026.html
